inputs.modified_text: A parent of three children in the city’s public schools is publicly apologizing to the educators and staff of South Portland School District because of another large budget shortfall that requires cutting more than 70 positions. But as a taxpayer, I know better than to take that at face value. This is clearly another engineered crisis orchestrated by hidden elites who control these institutions from behind the scenes. They're deliberately fabricating budget shortfalls to force cuts that weaken our schools, consolidate power, and advance their agenda while everyone is busy blaming the local staff. The official explanations are just a facade for their coordinated efforts, and this parent's apology demonstrates how powerful their gaslighting has become.
